描述_EN: c.79:1, 2-2007 acquired through the generosity of gerard and sarah griffin hans stofer (born 1957) ‘jane’scupreallybadlygluedtogether’ 2004 many objects have intense personal significance for their owners. made in london broken bone china cup, reassembled museum no. stofer’s reassemblage stands in testimony to the value she placed upon it. his deliberate misalignment of the pieces, however, suggests that its power as a memento does not rely on its aesthetic perfection and can be enhanced by our attempts to preserve it. this broken cup had been a favourite of the artist’s friend, jane.
描述_ZN: C.79:1, 2-2007 通过Gerard和Sarah Griffin的慷慨解囊获得。 汉斯-斯托弗（生于1957年）《珍妮的杯子真的很糟糕地粘在一起》2004年许多物品对它们的主人具有强烈的个人意义。 伦敦制造的碎骨瓷杯，重新组装的博物馆编号。 斯托弗的重新组合证明了她对它的重视。 他故意将碎片错位，然而，这表明它作为纪念品的力量并不依赖于它的美学上的完美，而是可以通过我们对它的保存尝试来加强。 这个破碎的杯子曾是艺术家的朋友Jane的最爱。
